dataset_name: Alibaton Performance & Development - Canonical Workforce Personas and Career Status
authority: Source of truth for defense/demo personnel stories, development tracks, and succession/promotion status until explicitly superseded.

relationship_to_other_files.note: Course/progress/certificate facts are copied only as a snapshot; detailed LMS truth remains in the LMS canonical file.

promotion_policy.canonical_decision: No active canonical person is represented as already promoted in V1.
promotion_policy.why: The current P&D build has succession/readiness capability but no governed promotion-history/personnel-action table. Inventing completed promotions would create an unsupported system claim.
promotion_policy.system_boundary: Performance & Development may assemble evidence and succession readiness, but it does not automatically promote, appoint, demote, or change employment positions.
promotion_or_appointment_basis: Current role and relevant experience / role adjacency
Finalized competency profile against the target role
Completed learning/training interventions and assessment outcomes
Required certificates or role qualifications where applicable
Business need / actual vacancy in the target position
HR validation and authorized management approval
decision_flow: Direct supervisor/evaluator submits a recommendation supported by finalized evidence.
HR Business Partner validates eligibility, evidence completeness, and policy compliance.
Authorized company management approves or rejects the personnel action outside automated P&D scoring.
If approved, the official personnel/position record is updated and P&D records the succession outcome; the system never changes the position merely because a candidate is Ready Now.

named_hr_governance_for_defense.note: These HR users validate/govern evidence. They do not unilaterally appoint employees to positions.

promotion_policy.ai_boundary: Groq/Aevyn may summarize or draft development recommendations only. It has zero authority to determine promotion, appointment, readiness finalization, or employment action.

trainee_policy.next_decision: Probationary re-evaluation followed by regularization/role-placement decision if requirements are met.
trainee_policy.not_a_promotion: Conversion from trainee/probationary status to an approved regular role is treated as a personnel placement/regularization decision, not as a promotion.

performance_evaluator_governance.default_evaluator_rule: The direct manager or formal reporting relationship is the default Performance evaluator when one is recorded.
performance_evaluator_governance.formal_progress_authority: Formal Goal/KPI progress and status are verified and maintained by the assigned evaluator or direct supervisor for the active Performance cycle.
performance_evaluator_governance.employee_evidence_rule: Employees may submit supporting work evidence when the workflow allows it, but employee-submitted evidence does not directly overwrite the formal Performance percentage.
performance_evaluator_governance.admin_hr_governance_rule: Admin and HR govern evaluator coverage and may make verified administrative corrections only with a required reason and audit trail; they do not arbitrarily set employee Performance results.
performance_evaluator_governance.exception_rule: If the default evaluator is unavailable or a special review requires another evaluator, the reassignment must be explicitly authorized, reasoned, and audited for the affected review.
performance_evaluator_governance.no_default_evaluator_rule: When no direct manager or default evaluator is recorded, a formal review cannot proceed until an authorized evaluator is explicitly assigned.
performance_evaluator_governance.goal_weight_rule: Published or assigned goal-plan weights are locked for the cycle. Material weight changes require a revised/new plan or a future cycle.
performance_evaluator_governance.review_lock_rule: After manager submission, calibration, or finalization, formal goal evidence is locked from ordinary edits; governed revision or correction workflows must be used.

performance_goal_governance.coverage_rule: Every eligible canonical workforce person in the active Performance cycle must have one governed Goal Plan totaling exactly 100% weight.
performance_goal_governance.plan_assignment_rule: Goal Plan assignment is based on canonical person type, department, position, and role context. Succession readiness does not determine Performance progress or rating.
performance_goal_governance.weight_rule: Goal Plan weights are design/governance values and must total 100%. Once a plan is assigned for a cycle, weights are locked; material changes require a revised/new plan or a future cycle.
performance_goal_governance.formal_progress_rule: Formal Goal/KPI progress and status are verified and maintained by the assigned Performance evaluator. Employees may submit supporting work evidence when enabled but cannot directly overwrite the formal percentage.
performance_goal_governance.admin_hr_correction_rule: Admin/HR may correct a verified record error only through an explicit Administrative Goal Correction with a required reason and audit trail.
performance_goal_governance.review_lock_rule: After manager submission, calibration, or finalization, ordinary goal-progress edits are locked.
performance_goal_governance.lms_boundary: Learning/LMS completion, Pre-Test/Post-Test scores, course progress, and certificates may support development follow-through but never calculate Performance goal progress or the final Performance rating.
performance_goal_governance.quarterly_cycle_rule: Performance reviews follow the governing quarterly policy: Q1 Jan-Mar, Q2 Apr-Jun, Q3 Jul-Sep, Q4 Oct-Dec, followed by a 15-day formal review window.
performance_goal_governance.historical_lock_rule: Finalized quarters are read-only across Performance. Ordinary edits, evaluator changes, and workflow mutations must not rewrite historical results.
performance_goal_governance.selector_scope_rule: The global Year + Quarter picker changes the selected period for the entire Performance module, including Overview, Goals & KPIs, Reviews, Feedback & Coaching, Performance Improvement, and Analytics.

performance_calendar.historical_data_before_2026_note: No Performance history is populated before 2026. Earlier years should not appear as selectable data until an authorized historical dataset is added.
performance_calendar.selector_rule: One global Performance period picker controls the entire Performance module. Finalized quarters are view-only; the current quarter is operational; future quarters remain locked until their performance start date.
performance_calendar.cycle_generation_rule: The system generates Q1-Q4 Performance periods from the governing quarterly policy and advances cycle state from dates without manual open/close actions.

performance_history_policy.quarterly_reset_rule: Each quarter creates a new cycle-specific Goal/KPI and review record. Prior quarters remain preserved and read-only; they are never reset or overwritten.
performance_history_policy.historical_visibility_rule: Previous quarters remain selectable for audit, comparison, review history, evaluator history, and trend analysis.
performance_history_policy.current_cycle_rule: Q3 2026 is the current working cycle as of this dataset date.
performance_history_policy.future_cycle_rule: Q4 2026 contains setup metadata only and must not contain fabricated future progress or ratings.
performance_history_policy.year_selector_rule: Only 2026 currently contains Performance data. Years 2025 and earlier are intentionally absent until an authorized historical dataset is added.
performance_history_policy.succession_boundary: Succession readiness is not used to calculate historical Performance progress or ratings.
performance_history_policy.lms_boundary: Learning, Training, certificates, and Pre-Test/Post-Test results do not calculate quarterly Performance percentages or ratings.
